title: Pennywise Prefill Controller: tenant-aware sample-shaping and graceful quant-failsafe
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Many tenants show bursty, low-signal traffic where a full-prefill and highest-quality quantization are unnecessary but costly. This PR introduces the Pennywise Prefill Controller, a small runtime component that shapes prefill/sample selection per-tenant by applying budget-aware sampling heuristics and a soft-fallthrough quantization policy. The goal is to reduce per-token unit economics for low-value requests while preserving quality for high-confidence paths. Changes: 1) New controller service (services/prefill) that computes per-tenant prefill intensity and candidate-sampling weights based on recent request histograms, tenant budget tiers, and SLO tags. 2) A graceful quant-failsafe path (runtime/quant) that allows requests to be downgraded through a small set of quant profiles (e.g., int8 -> int4-fast) with runtime quality checks and automatic rollback if quality regressions exceed thresholds. 3) Telemetry hooks that emit unit_econ.decisions and quant.fallback events tied to request ids so we can A/B and attribute cost savings. 4) CLI and docs to let platform engineers set tenant budgets and simulate downstream effects. Rollout plan: feature-flagged behind ff.prefill_pennywise for 10% shadow traffic for 48h, then tenant opt-in for conservative tiers, then progressive ramp. Safety: controller only affects prefill/sample shaping and quant fallback when model-compatibility is explicit; default policy is a no-op. We added a monitoring dashboard and regression alert that fires when latency or human-eval metrics degrade >2% over baseline. Tests: unit tests for heuristic logic and quant-failsafe simulation, integration tests that validate telemetry ingestion and rollback behavior, and a small perf smoke test. Related: ENG-1987 tracks the decision graph for budget tiers, SUP-4321 notes a customer incident where bursty traffic spiked costs. This PR is intentionally conservative in defaults and provides easy opt-out.
